name: umbra-btc-deposit-worker
description: Standalone btc_deposit proving worker — deliberately NOT part of the backend/ deployment (same reasoning as matcher-worker/, see its own README) and NOT matcher-worker's own EventBridge-scheduled Lambda (wrong cadence — BTC deposits have no matching/batching reason to wait for a scheduled tick the way match_orders does). Run this wherever you have real compute for Noir/Barretenberg proving; it talks to a running backend over HTTP.

scripts.package-lambda: pnpm run build && pnpm run sync-circuit && node scripts/package-lambda.js
